high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Bloomberg's website, specifically from the CityLab section. The headline reads: "UAE’s AI University Aims to Become Stanford of the Gulf." The subheading states that Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI is focused on building an engineering pipeline, incubating homegrown startups, and hypercharging the region's AI development. The article is authored by Omar El Chmouri and Mark Bergen, and it was published on May 23, 2025, at 2:00 AM EDT, with an update on the same day at 5:39 AM EDT
